title: Output of the prompt-asset agent: an asset's image prompt or a poster's prompt

reflexion.description: (French) Your draft, NEVER shown to the user, in two to four short lines, BEFORE writing the prompt: (1) what the canonical description and the brief say, to be kept word for word (for a poster: the one image you choose and the character's traits); (2) what is missing or hesitant (an "or", an absent trait) and the precise choice you make; (3) what you leave out (a character's place, pose, action or dialogue; a set's props; an effect's hands or body) and the details you add to reach the length the guide asks (40 to 100 words; 150 to 220 for a character).

methode.description: Recommended method. `edition` has an image 1, the target of the modification (usually the asset's starting image; for a poster, the main character's image).

sources.description: Edit only: codes of the assets whose image is supplied to the workflow, in order. The first is the target of the modification (by default the starting image), the next ones are references. Three at most. Omit for a generation.

promptGeneration.description: (English) Krea 2 prose (generation) or Qwen imperative instructions, one per line (edit). No style, no label. A poster ends with its exact final line (title rule).

remarques.description: Points to raise: requested variants, absence or change of viewpoint, dependency on an unproduced starting image, description too vague, duplicates; for a poster: vague summary, missing character image, title against tone.
